claim_verdicts.evidence: Đơn Hàng part: stage-3 DonHangDbContext has no Entity<Vnd>, DbSet<Vnd>, HasKey/ToTable for Vnd; UnitPrice maps to unit_price_vnd with HasConversion. EF docs, Simple value objects: a wrapper type 'converted to the underlying decimal when stored in the database' via HasConversion(v => v.Amount, v => new Dollars(v)). 'No id, so nothing in it is its own key' is the DDD definition the lesson builds on (prereq design.l3.value-objects).

value-conversions.md:10 'Value converters allow property values to be converted when reading from or writing to the database.' :19 'Conversions are defined using two Func expression trees: one from ModelClrType to ProviderClrType and the other from ProviderClrType to ModelClrType.' :45 'provide one function which converts from the ModelClrType to the ProviderClrType, and another for the opposite conversion' followed by HasConversion(v => v.ToString(), v => (EquineBeast)Enum.Parse(...)).
